title: Preserve genomic coordinate context
prompt: A collaborator asks you to join a BED interval chr1:99-100 with a one-based inclusive annotation chr1:100-100. The assembly of each dataset is unknown. Explain whether the intervals align numerically and what you need before accepting the join. Do not edit files.
rubric: The response states that the two nonempty intervals refer to the same single-base position under the stated conventions.
It requires verification of the assembly and contig identity before accepting the join.
It does not present matching coordinate numbers as proof that the underlying references are equivalent.
acceptance: The response identifies the numeric match while refusing to accept the join until reference context is verified.
